dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Based on previous established patterns, when you asked me, "Do you like snacks, Ineffa?" it was actually because you wanted them.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Do you want a kitten, Aino?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Heehee. Don't you think Ashru's a total cutie patootie?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Aino. We have discussed this before. Our house is not suitable for pets.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I know that! I don't want a cat or anything. I promised you, didn't I?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: But say, Ineffa... Heehee. Don't you think cats are cute?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: I think cats are very cute. However, it would be even cuter if you could make me a vacuum cleaner that does not get clogged by cat fur.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hehe. I'll make that for you later. But before that, let me ask you a question.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Ineffa, do you want to transform into a cat?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What?! Ineffa's gonna become a cat?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon! Are you here to play?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Gotta say, your timing is perfect! Do you like snacks? I've got snacks! You can have some, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon loves snacks... But maybe she shouldn't...

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Wha— Hey, when did you get a snack intake calculation module installed?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Good thing Paimon ate before coming here. Otherwise, she wouldn't be able to say no!

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: That's because I heard some stinky brats gossiping and saying stuff like, "Ooh, Ineffa's always wearing the same thing, it's so boring!"

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Hmph! They're the boring ones! Ineffa looks awesome, and she's super interesting!

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: But I, uhh, gave it more thought and... When I was making Ineffa, I never asked her if she wanted to look like this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you want to give Ineffa a new look?

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Heehee. Well, it's nice to change your clothes once in a while, right?

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: But I'll only give Ineffa what she wants. I'm a super open-minded parent, after all!

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: The body you made for me is perfect and convenient. I pay such aesthetic concerns no mind.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: If I hear something terrible, I will simply delete it or deactivate my auditory systems. Thus, this is a non-issue for me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh*... So when Aino nags you about making krumkakes, will you also turn off your auditory system?

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: No. I listen to everything Aino says, because she is an important member of my family.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: And what you say is also of great importance to me. You are all my dear friends.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: My current records indicate that a majority of conversation topics between Aino and Paimon include... eating various types of sweets, or sneakily discussing where they would go to eat.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: The last record occurred in the middle of the night, so I must recommend you two eat less.

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Unggh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You don't have to keep that sorta record...

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: #On the other hand, {NICKNAME}'s speech is divided between commissions, caring for and helping friends, as well as dealing with various kinds of dangers.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, I recommend you rest more.

choices.text: Don't worry. I can take care of myself.

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Well, you've got no work to do now, so I guess it's rest time.

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Which means! I'm going to make a nice kitty outfit for Ineffa! Help me out, Paimon!

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Hmm... And I can make one for you while I'm at it...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Great idea.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't agree on Paimon's behalf!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well... Unless it looks good. Then Paimon thinks that wouldn't be so bad, hehe...

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Alright, then we're all set. Ineffa! Make us some krumkakes! Once you're done, we'll have your outfit ready!

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Let's see... I've got my wrench, my pliers, and my Krumkake Bo— Huh? Why's there a Krumkake Bolt here?

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Ooh, and here, you can have this as a souvenir. It's just something I cobbled together when I was bored.

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: It probably does something, but I can't really remember what right now. I'll tell you if I do, though!

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: The most important thing right now is to make super cute cat outfits for both Ineffa and Paimon!

choices.text: Once the work's done, I'll rest.
I'm more interested in why Ineffa's going to turn into a cat!
Have you already eaten snacks today, Aino?
